content.comment_body: Hello, I've installed an analog expansion module to a [product_name] base module [article_no]. Currently, the sensor value is displayed on AI3. Is it possible to have this value shown on a different analog input channel? ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ This was split from discussion about [product_name] [article_no] with analog expansion module.

Could you please clarify your request? The analog input numbering depends on several factors. - If no analog inputs are active on the base module, the first analog input on the expansion module is labeled AI1. - If two analog inputs on the base module are active, the expansion's first input is AI3. - If four analog inputs on the base module are active, the expansion's first input is AI5.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unsure how analog input channels are assigned when connecting an analog expansion module to a [product_name] base unit. The discussion points to uncertainty about whether sensor readings from the expansion module can be displayed on a different analog input channel, revealing confusion about the configuration and mapping of input channels.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like the ability to reassign which analog input channel displays the sensor value, or at minimum have a clearer understanding of how input channels are mapped with expansion modules.
